description: Seller side: put your HTTP endpoint behind an L402 paywall on our gateway. Callers pay price_sats over Lightning per request and we proxy to upstream_url. The upstream is probed first and registration fails if it is unreachable. Registering does not spend funds. REQUIRES OPERATOR KEY.

category.description: Catalog category, for example data, finance or ai

description.description: What buyers get for each paid call, up to 500 characters

name.description: Public name of the paid endpoint, up to 100 characters, for example Weather Forecast API

price_sats.description: Price per call in satoshis (sats, not msats), integer 1 or more, for example 50

upstream_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent to your upstream, as a JSON object of header name to value, for example {"X-Api-Key": "secret"}

upstream_method.description: HTTP method used to call your upstream URL. Default GET

upstream_timeout_ms.description: Upstream timeout in milliseconds, 1000 to 30000, for example 10000

upstream_url.description: Public https URL of the endpoint to sell, for example https://api.example.com/v1/data. Private and localhost addresses are refused

name: gateway_register
